title: Spreadsheet Value Range
description: Schema for a range of values in a Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel spreadsheet, identified by A1 notation.

range.description: The range the values cover, in A1 notation (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:D10')

majorDimension.description: The primary orientation of the values array. ROWS means values[i] is the i-th row.

values.description: The data values in row-major or column-major order depending on majorDimension

items.description: A single row (or column if majorDimension=COLUMNS)
A cell value. Can be a string, number, boolean, or empty string.
